question: What come by Shiva-initiation for tattva-unity?
premises: also mantra-entitlement, and liberation, by Shiva-initiation
by this too it is declared
inference: Shiva-initiation grants mantra-right, freedom, and unity-siddhi.
plain_english: Also mantra-entitlement and liberation by Shiva-initiation — by this too it is declared — the yogin, for tattva-unity accomplishment.
